---
title: "Chess openings"
description: "How popular each chess opening is on Lichess, who chooses it, and how often you'd meet it compared with your opponent."
---

An interactive opening dashboard is coming soon.

For any of the roughly 3,800 named openings, it will show:

- how often games reach the opening, over time;
- whether White or Black is the one choosing it;
- how often *you* would see it compared with your opponent.
